Great but could use a few improvements. The White Noise app has quickly become my most used, especially while working from home, so being able to add some other sounds that keep my mind relaxed and focused has been tremendous! I have three suggestions that I think would really improve the overall user experience: (1) Add a feature to sort by most downloads, or add a ‘Top Charts’ list so it’s easy to find the crowd favorites. The UI is very large and bulky, making it time consuming to scroll past each sound to check the name and download count, before even previewing the actual sound. (2) Building off of the first point, make the listings smaller than what they are, which currently takes up nearly the entire space of your iPhone or iPad. You can never see more than two full sound listings at one time, I find myself ready to get off of the White Noise Market as fast as I can because it’s so unwieldy. (3) This may be a remark better left for the main White Noise app, but sync the added sounds across all devices logged into the same account would be helpful. The workaround is to make sure you ‘favorite’ the sounds you’re downloading on one device so you can easily go to your favorites on another devices and download them there again. Not a huge hurdle, but just a relatively small time saver.

reviews.text: Hate it!. I loved it until you changed it into social media. Can’t find a thing. I hate these changes!!!

Great app, devs seem to care. I’m a paying customer and sound contributer, plus I actually signed into the market just now. That’s basically vip status for white noise, yet, I just got the most intrusive/malicious ad I’ve ever seen since coming to iOS a year ago (worse than anything I’ve ever seen on android for that matter). It was a black jack card playing app, it pops up, there’s 3 buttons, 2 say ‘play’ and 1 says ‘clear’. There’s no ‘x’ anywhere, not even a sneaky dark grey one on a black background. And no normal timer either, just an ‘in game, timer of like 5min.
 
So yea, absolutely no way to click out or get rid of it, not even by waiting 30 seconds like the other breed of horribly intrusive ads. Even then I shouldn’t have even those sorts of ads if I payed money for the app, I won’t lie I thought that’s what the money was for. I still don’t have all the high end prebuilt sounds/features, no that’s for the ‘pro’ version. The trick is splitting the app into many parts and charging money for almost every piece. The white noise ‘market’ no one is even able to pay for even if they wanted to. So someone paying the top dollar ‘pro’ price still has to watch the very intrusive ads. Great app though, but after this ad I’m starting to seriously question the marketing strategies. Obviously it’s great for the dev, and that’s good, I just hope their not getting too greed/sold the app to China. Maybe they didn't review the ad, which is not a good practice IF that's the case, I'm hoping it was a mistake to let that type of ad through though. I just can't imagine tmsoft making those types of malicious, app crashing ads the new normal.

So that’s where I’m at. I had to kill and clear the app from my cache just to escape the ad. We need to get rid of this blackjack/21 malvertising, otherwise I'll be clearing from cache and uninstalling the whole white noise market. 

I'll give you guys some time to look into this ad, white noise is a great app that I've contributed to, but if I'm gonna be trapped inside an ad everytime, I'll have to rerhink my sleep strategy. 

Also I do agree with others, I don't like the new market layout, there are thousands of sounds and now we can only see 1 at a time, where as 
before it was tiled and we could see and read about several at once. Please bring back tile view, make it optional if you want, but we want to see the picture and title of many sounds at once.

Update: Thanks for the response that's awesome. I'd like to believe you would have responded even if my original review title wasn't as colorful as 'malvertising' but i wanted you guys to see it and pull the ad asap if it was a mistake, and if it would have been intentional, well the ad itself fits the description. I described the ad in detail in the hopes you can find it and pull it. 
 Its interesting how much 1 rogue ad can change ones viewpoint on a developer. First I was like 'yea love white noise, it's community oriented, yada yada'.. Then I get an ad I cant escape, and I'm like 'man they take free sounds from the community, and make the community buy the app to use the sounds they uploaded, and then have the nerve to pull this adware crap'... lol.. Maybe a lesson in here about the importance of not letting rogue ads through. 

But yea I get you have to pay for the infrastructure, platform, bandwidth, it's a great value for the customers actually, we get a lot with the low price we pay, even if some of it comes from us. White noise market also provides the means to discover new sounds too, so again its a great symbiotic relationship, it seems, between tmsoft and the community. 

Thanks for your thoughtful reply, hope to get tile view back one day. Please vet ads better if that's possible. 

White noise is still the best sleep app. By far.
